```python
def test_f():
    # Single element: 1 is odd -> sum 1..1 = 1
    assert f(1) == [1]
    # 2 is even -> 2! = 2
    assert f(2) == [1, 2]
    # 3 is odd -> 1+2+3 = 6
    assert f(3) == [1, 2, 6]
    # 4 is even -> 4! = 24
    assert f(4) == [1, 2, 6, 24]
    # Mixed sequence up to 5
    assert f(5) == [1, 2, 6, 24, 15]
    # Longer sequence up to 8
    assert f(8) == [1, 2, 6, 24, 15, 720, 28, 40320]
    # Edge case: n = 0 returns empty list
    assert f(0) == []
```
